title: Integrating agrivoltaics with batteries for rural energy and food security in West Africa
content:
Agrivoltaics offers a sustainable solution to competing land-use demands by integrating solar energy generation and agriculture, enhancing food security, water efficiency and rural livelihoods. Combined with battery energy storage, it can strengthen energy reliability, economic viability and climate resilience in rural West Africa, particularly in Nigeria and Ghana.

title: New model optimizes perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells for satellites
content:
South Korean-led researchers have identified optimal perovskite absorber thicknesses and bandgaps for tandem solar cells operating in different satellite orbits. Their simulations indicate that bromide-rich perovskites offer superior current matching, greater thickness tolerance, and projected efficiencies of up to 29%.

title: Leading the energy transition: stereotypes, AI and what stays human
content: This week, Women in Solar+ Europe (WiSEu) and Solar+ Leaders reflect on two workshops held in Madrid during Genera that examined how bias shapes everyday leadership decisions in the energy transition. title: How cellular base stations may affect solar module performance
content:
Researchers in Burkina Faso have found that radio-frequency electromagnetic fields may alter the internal electrical parameters and power output of solar modules. Their outdoor experiments revealed nonlinear effects depending on field intensity and antenna radiation patterns.
